summary: {person} narrows a precautionary advisory to the residents at greatest risk.
realLife: Governor Richard Thornburgh advised pregnant women and families with preschool children near Three Mile Island to leave temporarily.
gates: The executive has authority to issue an advisory for the affected area.
weights: A risk assessment that distinguishes populations favors a narrower advisory.
inGame: needs: the groups and places covered by a public advisory.

turns.what: The advisory covers everyone inside the designated area.
turns.pulledBy: The forecast puts every household there at risk.
turns.writesBack: The notice covers all residents within the boundary.
